skills.description: Generate short films where the user becomes the protagonist of their favorite movies. This skill is triggered when a user provides (1) a personal photo, (2) a nickname or character name, and (3) the name of a movie plus a description of the iconic scene to remake. It produces a 10–30 second short video that recreates the cinematic atmosphere of the referenced film with the user as the leading character, by orchestrating ImageGen (image-to-image keyframes), VideoGen (image-to-video clips), FFmpeg-based stitching with burned-in subtitles, crossfade/flash transitions, and cue-aligned BGM (auto-detect BGM beats and snap shot transitions to strong beats). Typical trigger phrases include "我当主角", "我演 XX 电影", "电影同款短片", "be the star of XX", "remake this scene with me", or any request to place the user into a movie's signature moment. Do not use this skill for: pure photo retouching, generic avatar generation unrelated to a film scene, or fully custom non-cinematic personal branding clips.
